relationship_to_game_rules: Patch strategy overrides tune coaching priors only. They do not define game-rule timing, augment stages, choice pretriggers, base economy math, or leveling thresholds.

economy_management_overrides.patch_scope: S17.8 balance/meta bias; supersede this file when a later patch changes the live tempo or evidence.
economy_management_overrides.relationship_to_base: Overrides only patch tempo and decision priors. Base economy compounding, interest math, and leveling thresholds still apply.

tempo_bias.summary: Treat S17.8 as a tempo-sensitive patch where current board quality, item fit, confirmed choices, HP, economy, and promoted live rankings decide whether to push or greed.
tempo_bias.single_open_risk: Do not assume the balance patch alone makes an open-loss line safe; require a structured streak plan and a credible stabilizing endpoint.
tempo_bias.preferred_default: Use strongest-board economy unless current-match facts and live ranking evidence justify preserving a deliberate streak or accelerating a specific cap line.

early_leveling_bias.level_4: Level only when current units plus components make a real combat board, or when a confirmed tempo, HP-protection, or economy source justifies the spend.
do_not_level_when: the board does not have real pairs or two-star pressure
components do not fit current holders
there is no extra economy source and leveling would break important interest without likely wins
early_leveling_bias.recovery_policy: If an early tempo spend fails to preserve strength, stop compounding it: recover interest, release low-value holds, and reassess at the next material decision point.

contested_meta_policy.summary: Use promoted live rankings and current-match fit to judge contested lines; balance changes are soft priors, never proof that a composition is forced or uncontested.

fast_8_timing.default_4_cost_line: 4-2 level 8 after the augment is the normal four-cost timing when economy permits.
fast_8_timing.4_1_contest: 4-1 level 8 can be correct when rich, low on HP, or racing a contested pool, but the immediate combat gain must justify the lost economy.
fast_8_timing.4_5_delay: Delay to 4-5 only when HP, board strength, and contest evidence make the extra economy safe.

host_model_policy: S17.8 buffs to Briar, Twisted Fate, Miss Fortune, Riven, and several Psionic Agent equipment effects are soft direction signals only; require live board, item, augment, economy, and ranking fit before recommending commitment.

S17.8 nerfs to Akali, Samira, Diana, the five-Invoker breakpoint, and several Anima Squad equipment effects do not force an automatic pivot; explain whether the current line still meets its survival and cap conditions.

When user target and live ranking evidence conflict, explain the decision through current board fit, item fit, confirmed choices, HP/economy, contest evidence, and the next hit that would justify staying or pivoting.

event_policy.patch_reason: S17.8 keeps the S17 choice windows while changing combat balance. These are review priors only and never override live HP, confirmed choices, board quality, item fit, user target, or contest facts.
